reddit.title: Explore the New Conquest Mode in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're excited to share insights about our latest update, which introduces a fresh campaign mode in Provincia. In **Tutorial 2 · Conquest**, you'll navigate a constrained home basin and unlock five unique territories through strategic battles. Each territory offers different rewards and challenges, providing a rich gameplay experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

steam.title: Conquest Mode Now Available in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce the launch of **Tutorial 2 · Conquest**! This new campaign mode allows you to conquer five territories, each with distinct rewards and challenges. Engage in strategic battles to expand your colony and uncover the map. For more information on how to play, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin
